payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-18: this is now failing the scheduled monitor continuously, not intermittently. The Live domain monitor workflow has concluded 'failure' on every scheduled run checked (runs 266, 267 and 268, 2026-09-17 06:47 / 12:41 / 18:36 UTC), always at the same step: 'services: answering from the in-bundle catalogue because the published one could not be read.' The other two probes are healthy in the same runs (forms 5 results in 1132ms, medications 5 in 1217ms), and the deployment-freshness step passes, so the red is specific and accurate. That makes this a live worked example of #TN512M: the check exists, it is correct, it is cost-free, it has been red for days, and it reached nobody -- the owner reported the underlying site problems from a browser instead. Nothing was changed here; recording the escalation from inferred to continuously observed.
